problem: The Instagram media router rewrote a verified live publication from LIVE_PROVEN to REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED.
root_cause: The router treated any historical external_id combined with republish_forbidden as replacement-required before checking terminal provider acknowledgement/readback.
prevention: Terminal provider truth has precedence. If external_id exists and provider ack/readback/terminal-side-effect is verified, upsert media job as LIVE_PROVEN and prohibit replacement. Replacement logic only applies to historical unproven/blocked side effects.
